_about: Item sources and notes the game data scan does not find on its own, each verified in the untouched Chinese v4.0.3 ROM (2026-10-05; evidence in work/notes/availability_audit.md). "sources" are added to the item page; "note" explains an item with no confirmed source.

entries.name: Nanab Berry
entries.note: A Pal Park Catching Show prize for a score of 3,300–3,499 points (1 in 7 at that score), but only in the normal show, which needs six Pokémon migrated from a Game Boy Advance game (a DS or DS Lite with the GBA slot). Fixed Catch mode never ends with a score or a prize (tested in an emulator). Otherwise only from the Spin Trade game (wireless, with other players).

sources.note: 3 cards for 1 BP; a card showing the same picture three times pays its prize.

entries.note: Only held by trainers' Pokémon. It pops when the Pokémon holding it is hit, so it can't be stolen with Thief or Covet (tested in an emulator). Another Air Balloon can be obtained; it is listed separately.

sources.note: A Pokémon with Pickup sometimes finds it after a battle.
